answer_1.quote: feedback comment generation is a task where given a text and a span, a system generates, for the span, an explanatory note that helps the writer (language learner) improve their writing skills
answer_1.outputs: feedback comments explaining why a span is not good with underlying rules

answer_2.quote: we simply take BLEU between a system output and its corresponding reference

answer_4.quote: human evaluators examine whether a system output and its corresponding reference are equivalent in meaning
answer_4.guideline: it contains information similar to the reference and it does not contain information that is irrelevant to the span; it may contain information that the reference does not contain as long as it is relevant to the span
